title: gpu_inference.dead_letter
description: An inference request landed in the dead-letter queue. The reason discriminator separates customer errors (malformed_input: the worker rejected the body and sent it to the DLQ explicitly) from system errors (processing_exhausted: SQS redrove the message after maxReceiveCount failed attempts).

inference.dlq.reason.description: Discriminator. malformed_input = customer error; processing_exhausted = system error.

inference.dlq.reason_code.description: Stable machine code. The allowed set depends on inference.dlq.reason (see if/then below).

inference.dlq.source_queue.description: Queue the message came from: the OriginalQueue URL on the explicit path, or the DeadLetterQueueSourceArn on the redrive path.

messaging.message.id.description: SQS MessageId of the source message.

inference.request.id.description: Present when the body parsed far enough to yield a valid requestId. Always present for processing_exhausted.

inference.dlq.receive_count.description: ApproximateReceiveCount when the message was dead-lettered. Required for processing_exhausted.

inference.request.enqueued_at.description: SQS SentTimestamp of the original request.

inference.dlq.error_message.description: Human-readable detail (today's free-text ErrorReason, or the last exception message). Not for matching; use reason_code.
